question.problem:
Let ${X}_{1},{X}_{2},…,{X}_{108}$ be a random sample of size $n=108$ from a population with a population mean $\mu =20$ and population standard deviation $\sigma =90.$ Find an approximation for $P(|\overset{―}{X}|<5).$ *Hint: Two tables of values of $Φ(z)$ for different values of $z$ are given below, where $Φ(z)$ is the cumulative distribution function for the standard normal distribution. *
$z$$\,0.07\,$$\,0.08\,$$\,0.09\,$
$\,-2.8\,$ $\,0.0021\,$ $\,0.0020\,$ $\,0.0019\,$
$\,-2.7\,$ $\,0.0028\,$ $\,0.0027\,$ $\,0.0026\,$
$\,-2.6\,$ $\,0.0038\,$ $\,0.0037\,$ $\,0.0036\,$

$z$$\,0.02\,$$\,0.03\,$$\,0.04\,$
$\,-1.8\,$ $\,0.0344\,$ $\,0.0336\,$ $\,0.0329\,$
$\,-1.7\,$ $\,0.0427\,$ $\,0.0418\,$ $\,0.0409\,$
$\,-1.6\,$ $\,0.0526\,$ $\,0.0516\,$ $\,0.0505\,$
question.worked_solution:
Suppose that ${X}_{1},{X}_{2},…,{X}_{n}$ is a random sample of size $n$ from a population with a population mean $\mu $ and population standard deviation $\sigma .$ The central limit theorem (or CLT) states that for sufficiently large $n,$ the distribution of the sample mean $\overset{―}{X}$ can be approximated as 

$$
\overset{―}{X}∼N\,(\mu ,\frac{{\sigma }^{2}}{n}).
$$

In our case, we have

$$
n=108,\,\mu =20,\,\sigma =90.
$$

Therefore, by the CLT, we have that the distribution of the sample mean can be approximated as

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{X} & ∼N\,(\mu ,\frac{{\sigma }^{2}}{n}) \\  & ∼N\,(20,\frac{{90}^{2}}{108}) \\  & ∼N(20,75).\end{aligned}
$$

We want to find $P(|\overset{―}{X}|<5).$ So, we convert $\overset{―}{X}$ to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(|\overset{―}{X}|<5) & =P(-5<\overset{―}{X}<5) \\  & =P(\frac{-5-20}{\sqrt{75}}<Z<\frac{5-20}{\sqrt{75}}) \\  & =P(-\frac{5}{\sqrt{3}}<Z<-\frac{3}{\sqrt{3}}) \\  & ≈P(-2.89<Z<-1.73) \\  & =P(Z<-1.73)-P(Z<-2.89) \\  & =Φ(-1.73)-Φ(-2.89).\end{aligned}
$$

From the tables, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}Φ(-2.89)=0.0019, \\ Φ(-1.73)=0.0418.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(|\overset{―}{X}|<5) & =Φ(-1.73)-Φ(-2.89) \\  & =0.0418-0.0019 \\  & =0.0399.\end{aligned}
$$
